description: With leading-and-trailing behavior, a multi-invocation burst produces a leading invocation and a trailing invocation, and then a further invocation that arrives only after the quiet period has fully elapsed is recognized as a fresh leading edge and runs again. A burst of two invocations followed by one more invocation past the quiet window therefore yields three invocations in total.

cases.expected_output:
call#1 args=[] tag=fn
call#2 args=[] tag=fn
call#3 args=[] tag=fn
calls=3
